Goal includes many predicates for shift_candidate_alpha and shift_candidate_beta, as well as origin_availability_alpha and destination_availability_alpha.

We need to see which actions apply to which candidates.

First, shift_candidate_alpha is a schedule_candidate. It has initial facts: candidate_created, candidate_prepared, candidate_task_profile_linked route_task_profile_alpha, candidate_vehicle_linked vehicle_unit_gamma, candidate_operator_linked driver_operator_alpha, candidate_loading_container_linked loading_container_alpha, candidate_transport_leg_linked transport_leg_alpha, candidate_operational_constraint_linked operational_constraint_alpha, candidate_origin_availability_linked origin_availability_alpha, candidate_destination_availability_linked destination_availability_alpha.

- compliance_validation_complete shift_candidate_alpha

- operator_alignment_confirmed shift_candidate_alpha
- dispatch_ready shift_candidate_alpha

- candidate_prepared shift_candidate_alpha (already true)

- candidate_skill_certificate_linked shift_candidate_alpha skill_certificate_alpha (needs linking)
- candidate_loading_verified shift_candidate_alpha? Actually goal includes candidate_loading_verified shift_candidate_beta, not shift_candidate_alpha. So shift_candidate_alpha does not need loading verified.

Thus shift_candidate_alpha needs to go through compliance validation, operator alignment, constraint applied, etc.

Specifically, to get compliance_validation_complete, we need to verify_compliance_certificate, which requires operator_alignment_confirmed and compliance_certificate linked.

Operator_alignment_confirmed requires constraint_applied and operator linked.

Constraint_applied requires apply_operational_constraint, which needs candidate_prepared (true), candidate_task_profile_linked (true), operational_constraint_available (true initially), candidate_operational_constraint_linked (true), not already applied.

Thus we can apply operational constraint for shift_candidate_alpha using operational_constraint_alpha (available) and route_task_profile_alpha (linked). That will set constraint_applied and make operational_constraint_alpha unavailable.

Then confirm_operator_alignment for shift_candidate_alpha with driver_operator_alpha (already linked). That will set operator_alignment_confirmed.

Then assign_compliance_certificate to shift_candidate_alpha using compliance_certificate_alpha (available). That will link compliance certificate.

Then verify_compliance_certificate for shift_candidate_alpha with compliance_certificate_alpha, which will set compliance_validation_complete.

Then finalize_candidate_after_compliance_validation for shift_candidate_alpha, which will set candidate_finalized and dispatch_ready.

Alternatively, we could also finalize_candidate_direct if clearance established, but we don't need clearance for shift_candidate_alpha.

Thus shift_candidate_alpha can be finalized via compliance path.

- candidate_task_profile_linked shift_candidate_beta route_task_profile_alpha
- candidate_vehicle_linked shift_candidate_beta vehicle_unit_gamma
- candidate_finalized shift_candidate_beta? Actually goal includes candidate_finalized shift_candidate_alpha only, not shift_candidate_beta. So shift_candidate_beta does not need to be finalized.

Thus shift_candidate_beta needs to be prepared, have task profile linked, operator linked, skill certificate linked, compliance certificate linked, staged for loading, loading verified, clearance established.

Also need loading_container_beta to be loaded onto transport_leg_alpha and linked.

Also need loading_container_beta to be loaded (loading_container_loaded) and leg linked.

Also need transport_leg_alpha to be assembled, loading authorized, origin and destination nodes linked, etc.

We also need to lock origin and destination availabilities, confirm them, etc.

We need to assemble transport_leg_alpha (maybe fully loaded or nominal). Since we have loading_container_beta to be loaded onto transport_leg_alpha, we need to load container onto leg, then maybe assemble leg.

We need to see which assembly actions are applicable.

We have transport_leg_alpha initially available (transport_leg_available true). We have origin_availability_alpha and destination_availability_alpha locked? Not yet. We have origin_node_alpha and destination_node_alpha not ready nor occupied.

To lock origin_availability_alpha, we need candidate_prepared origin_availability_alpha, candidate_operator_linked origin_availability_alpha driver_operator_alpha, origin_availability_node_linked origin_availability_alpha origin_node_alpha, origin_node_ready origin_node_alpha, and not locked. So we need origin_availability_alpha to be prepared, operator linked, node ready.
